description: This file contains LLDP (Link Layer Discovery Protocol) definitions, data structures, macros, and function prototypes for configuring and handling LLDP packets within the Zephyr networking stack.

methods.name: net_lldp_config
methods.description: Sets the LLDP data unit for a network interface.

methods.name: net_lldp_config_optional
methods.description: Sets optional LLDP TLVs for a network interface.

methods.name: net_lldp_register_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for LLDP packet reception.

methods.name: net_lldp_recv
methods.description: Parses an LLDP packet and determines policy.

methods.name: net_lldp_set_lldpdu
methods.description: Sets the LLDP protocol data unit for a network interface.

methods.name: net_lldp_unset_lldpdu
methods.description: Unsets the LLDP protocol data unit for a network interface.
